suggestions.topic: Glamsterdam security issue impact analysis and mainnet fork decision
suggestions.rationale: ChainSecurity discovered EIP-8037/8038 repricing vulnerability affecting 13 major DeFi projects. Hoodi fork canceled; mainnet date on hold pending full impact analysis. This is the most critical blocking decision for Glamsterdam.

suggestions.topic: EIP-7907 (contract size metering) Hegota CFI/DFI decision
suggestions.rationale: Deferred from ACDE #247 with explicit 'next call' revisit expectation. Ben Adams raised PFI citing DoS surface created by EIP-7954's contract limit increase without metering. Decision is overdue.

suggestions.topic: bogota-devnet-2 status and hegota-devnet-0 launch readiness
suggestions.rationale: bogota-devnet-2 (EIP-8253, 4758, 8298, 8151) was scheduled to launch week of Oct 26. First merged hegota-devnet-0 targets post-Devcon. With Devcon just concluded, status update and next devnet planning are critical for Hegota progress.

suggestions.topic: FOCIL and Frames (EIP-8141) integration design decisions
suggestions.rationale: ACDE #248 noted FOCIL/frames interaction discussions to begin at Devcon. EIP-8141 is the Hegota headliner; resolving CL/EL integration questions is essential before merged devnets can proceed.
Both remain PFI pending ≥30 days of mainnet Glamsterdam data. With mainnet fork now delayed to 2027, the decision timeline needs recalibration — likely pushed significantly further out.

suggestions.topic: Hegota CFI prioritization and SFI readiness
suggestions.rationale: ACDE #248 adopted nixo's CFI priority ordering as working V1 and debated raising the CFI bar. With ~20 CFI EIPs and complexity concerns flagged (already most complex fork pre-PFI), need to clarify SFI criteria and timeline.

suggestions.topic: CL block retention window and BAL alignment resolution
suggestions.rationale: Deferred to async discussion in ETH R&D Discord (ACDE #246). Marked non-blocking for Gloas, but impacts EIP-8383 and history expiry. May have been resolved offline; worth confirming status.

suggestions.topic: EIP-8077 (eth/xx mempool networking) expanded scope review
suggestions.rationale: CFI'd conditionally on champion expanding spec to include fee/frame fields beyond sender+nonce. Champion was tasked with this expansion (ACDE #247); no update in #248. Low priority as CFI is provisional.
